articles.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
articles.snippet: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

articles.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

articles.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
articles.snippet: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

articles.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
articles.snippet: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.
